c124666701.reason: no-urinating pictogram with fine ('BOETE 3500'); no place name

c124666705.reason: no-urinating pictogram with fine, same sign as c124666701

c124738363.notes: Weathered company billboard on the Afobakaweg with four arrow-shaped direction panels over a photo of smiling workers (photo faces are part of the print, not the subject). Seen from the roadside at a distance. Distractors: 'PLEASE DRIVE SAFE' tag, 'Supporting our community' strip, a small 'BROWNSWEG' fingerpost at far left and partly hidden boards below ('...ier Plant...').

c124570317.reason: airport building name cut off at the frame edge ('...AIRPORT'); remaining banner is a slogan ('Welcome to Suriname / The most forested country in the world')

lines.text: PARAMARIBO | Historic Inner City | Historische Binnenstad

c151549327.notes: Tall bilingual Dutch/English heritage board at Fort Zeelandia, Paramaribo (UNESCO World Heritage logos top right: 'PATRIMOINE MONDIAL / WORLD HERITAGE / WERELDERFGOED'). Only the headers are transcribed; long body text and a small site map ('Plattegrond / Map of Fort Zeelandia', 'SURINAMERIVIER') follow.

c10778006.notes: White wooden cross-bar street sign with black stencilled letters in Paramaribo, shot from below against the sky.

c10821353.notes: Old hand-lettered distance fingerpost in central Paramaribo (left board westbound, right board eastbound, km). Top lines are faded and the right board is partly in shadow. A third board above is edge-on. Distractors: 'GARAGE DE PAARL' van, red '...SS ...RIVAP...' shop lettering behind, traffic in front.

c9797647.notes: Weathered white place-name board on a roadside frame at Lelydorp (Kofi-Djompo is the local name). Distractors: yellow LOTTO billboard ('VOLGENDE JACKPOT SRD. 450.000'), 'drempel' sign, pedestrian and traffic incidental.

c10778198.reason: near-duplicate of c10821353 (same Paramaribo distance fingerpost, wider view)

c68283434.notes: Yellow wooden street board with black stencilled letters on a concrete post near Fort Nieuw Amsterdam; a full rubbish rack beside it.

c68283355.notes: Two raised-letter name panels on the tax office in Nieuw Nickerie (upper on the first-floor parapet, lower over the entrance). Small 'NO SMOKING' sign on the door.

c68283362.notes: Hand-painted butcher's shop fascia in Nieuw Nickerie with crescent moons and a halal roundel. The opening-hours line is cut off at the air-conditioner on the right; a longer painted paragraph on the wall is partly hidden by a column. 'Juwelier Ramdaran Avinash' gilt window lettering is a distractor (partly hidden).

c10721126.notes: Rustic plank sign with white stencilled letters and a brass-lettered strip below, at the art academy in Paramaribo; red wagon-wheel hay rake beside it.

c62085932.notes: Bilingual Dutch/English heritage board at the synagogue ruin in Jodensavanne; only the two headers are transcribed. Body text, captions ('...Beracha ve Shalom, oftewel Zegen en Vrede.'), 'Stichting Jodensavanne' and World Monuments Fund footer follow. Board is stained and has stray bullet-like holes.

c62085933.reason: near-duplicate of c62085932 (second panel of the same Beracha ve Shalom board)

c4165966.notes: Hand-painted hanging stall sign (pig, star, palm-tree drawings) at the Paramaribo market; 'PARADYS' uses the Surinamese Y for IJ. Distractors: smaller 'ZOUTVLEES' boards, A-frame 'GEACHTE KLANTEN HIER IS SOWTU' and a second A-frame with small text; vendors and passers-by incidental.

c66722716.notes: 1947 black-and-white photo of the plantation name board of Uitkijk on the Saramacca river, framed on two posts, with a wooden church behind.
